forward_formulas.NH_over_FO_B_if_photon_g: Dg_FO/Dg_NH; only for a complete parent inventory
forward_formulas.B_relation: At unchanged E, pure multipole,tau and same fraction hypothesis, B=Tgamma/[K_L E^(2L+1)], so the rate multiplier is exactly the nominal B multiplier; no constant or lifetime-unit inference is needed for the ratio.

boundaries.model: FO/NH are vacancy treatments, not NP/no penetration. Both ordinary DF calculations use their nuclear-current approximation; no additional penetration fit is performed.
boundaries.data_identity: Provider-reported program dataset/version are authenticated. Remote binary/data-file hashes are not published/obtained; exact HTTP responses support offline retrieval replay.
boundaries.shared_models: All five outputs are theoretical inputs sharing atomic method/table assumptions. FO-NH spread is a deterministic model sensitivity, not an independent 1sigma or five experimental replications.
boundaries.theory_uncertainty: Adopted 1.4% includes interpolation; do not add the separate approximately0.3% interpolation accuracy again. No covariance matrix or full error budget is supplied.
boundaries.coverage: Preserve every returned N6 blank/warning and reported Tot, without filling zero or extrapolating. Forward rates using reported totals with missing-row warnings are nominal, not strict all-shell closure.
boundaries.inventory: Both given-number g and beta interpretations remain conditional on the complete listed branches and no extra uncounted decays; neither identifies MU08 actual processing.

boundaries.author_assumptions: Given pure-M1/E2 hypotheses are retained; no measured delta, higher-multipole exclusion or model ranking is created.

boundaries.printed_precision: Sensitivity values are arithmetic from rounded program-reported Tot/K values. A displayed zero FO-NH difference means no difference resolved at that printing precision, not equality of unrounded physical calculations. Extra decimal digits in forward ratios are computational precision, not input or experimental precision.
